criteriaCoverage.originalIntent: Analyze Korean pathology-material release process and costs for a proposed cancer-vaccine workflow, then deliver a cited Korean PDF.
criteriaCoverage.desiredOutcome: A practical report that distinguishes material forms, hospital-policy variation, measured versus assumed costs, and clinical/legal limits.
criteriaCoverage.userOutcomeReview: PDF includes source-linked process, cost scenarios, receiver/originating-hospital checklists, limitations, and 23 numbered references.
